newsitem.title: USA: CBS to give Clinton, Dole free air time.
newsitem.headline: CBS to give Clinton, Dole free air time.

text.p: CBS Inc said on Friday it would give President Bill Clinton and Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole free and unedited time on its television and radio stations.
Both candidates' campaigns accepted the offer, it said in a statement.

The candidates would each be given two to two and a half one minutes to speak on issues in an undedited and unfiltered segment, the company said. A CBS News Poll would determine four issues of great concern to the U.S. voter.
The candidates' responses would be aired on CBS evening news with commentator Dan Rather, and over other company television and radio stations.
The first broadcast would be on October 21, the company said.
